evals.prompt: 새 Node.js 프로젝트에 release-it을 설정해줘. GitHub Release를 자동 생성하고, conventional-changelog로 CHANGELOG.md를 관리하고, main 브랜치에서만 릴리스할 수 있게 해줘. CI에서 사용할 GitHub Actions 워크플로우도 만들어줘.
evals.expected_output: .release-it.json (or equivalent) with git.requireBranch=main, github.release=true, @release-it/conventional-changelog plugin config, and a GitHub Actions workflow YAML file

assertions.text: A release-it config file exists in outputs
Config has github.release set to true
Config has git.requireBranch set to 'main'
Config includes @release-it/conventional-changelog plugin with preset and infile
A GitHub Actions workflow YAML file exists with release-it --ci command
GitHub Actions workflow references GITHUB_TOKEN and NPM_TOKEN
GitHub Actions checkout uses fetch-depth: 0
Config includes $schema URL for IDE autocomplete

evals.expected_output: Updated .release-it.json with hooks, github.release with assets, and pre-release instructions

assertions.text: Config has hooks.before:init with lint and/or test commands
Config has hooks.after:bump with build command
Config has github.release set to true
Config has github.assets with dist/*.zip or similar glob
Output includes pre-release instructions with --preRelease=beta
Improved config preserves original git.commitMessage and npm.publish
The output .release-it.json is valid JSON

evals.prompt: release-it 커스텀 플러그인을 만들어줘. VERSION.txt 파일에서 버전을 읽고 쓰고, 릴리스 후에 Slack webhook으로 알림을 보내는 플러그인이야. npm의 기본 버전 관리는 비활성화해야 해.
evals.expected_output: Custom plugin JS file with getLatestVersion(), bump(), release/afterRelease with Slack webhook, disablePlugin(), and sample config

assertions.text: Plugin class extends Plugin from release-it
Plugin implements getLatestVersion() reading VERSION.txt
Plugin implements bump(version) writing VERSION.txt
Plugin implements Slack webhook POST in release() or afterRelease()
Plugin has static disablePlugin() returning 'npm' or config uses npm: false
Plugin uses this.step() for interactive prompt/spinner
A sample .release-it.json config showing plugin registration exists
Plugin uses ESM syntax (import/export)
